role: Core data structures for Layer 2 perception pipeline: frames, detections, tracked objects, and persistence query results.
detail: Defines immutable domain types that flow through the perception pipeline without CV library dependencies. TrackState (StrEnum) has four states: TENTATIVE (new track waiting confirmation), CONFIRMED (stable, Layer 3-eligible), LOST (unmatched frames but not deleted), DELETED (exceeded max_lost_frames threshold). TrackId is a NewType-wrapped int for type safety. Frame is immutable (frozen=True), stores raw JPEG/pixel bytes instead of numpy arrays, with frame_id, frame_sequence (monotonic), observed_at (UTC), width/height, and session_id. Detection holds YOLO output: label_raw, confidence [0.0, 1.0], and bbox coordinates (x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max in pixel space, top-left origin). FeatureProfile optionally stores dominant_colors (list of RGB tuples [0-255]) and embedding (list of floats from EfficientNet-B0). TrackedObject aggregates per-frame detections into session-scoped identity: track_id, state, most recent detection, features, frames_seen (cumulative matches), frames_lost (consecutive unmatched frames reset on recovery), first_seen_at, last_seen_at. FaceDetection (from MediaPipe) includes confidence, bbox, 478-point landmarks tuple list, blendshapes dict (expression names to [0.0,1.0] scores). PersistenceResult is Layer 3 match response: matched_node_id (string or None), confidence [0.0, 1.0], match_type ("embedding", "spatial", "label", "none"), surprise_flag (Piaget R2 novelty signal when detection mismatches spatial prediction), ambiguous_candidates (list of NodeIds scoring above ambiguity but below match threshold).
gotchas: Frame.data intentionally bytes (not numpy array) for import-time speed and testability without CV libraries. All models frozen=True for immutability; state transitions create new instances. FeatureProfile fields optional (extraction may fail on small/blurry crops). TrackId is type-safe NewType but still int at runtime. PersistenceResult surprise_flag implements Piaget R2 novelty gate for observation ingestion elevation.
